name: Akeneno Hitomi
source: A high school student. She is a "double psychic"; able to use two psychic abilities. In her case, she can use both telekinesis to remotely move objects and clairvoyance to see through surfaces.
translation: A high school student. She is a "double psychic"; able to use two psychic abilities. In her case, she can use both telekinesis to remotely move objects and clairvoyance to see through surfaces.
